option_relations.rationale: The option 'Systemic amyloidosis' matches the leaf labels for B1.1, B2.1, and B4.1, which all describe the same clinical entity.
The option 'Systemic AL amyloidosis' is a subtype of the leaf labels for B1.1, B2.1, and B4.1, which describe systemic amyloidosis.
The option 'Primary systemic (AL) amyloidosis' is a subtype of the leaf labels for B1.1, B2.1, and B4.1, which describe systemic amyloidosis.
The option 'Multiple myeloma-associated amyloidosis' is a subtype of the leaf labels for B1.1, B2.1, and B4.1, which describe systemic amyloidosis, but it is a more specific condition.
